THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)

Notice under Section 7 My Ref. No.: ඉඅ/5/1/295/(11). Ministry of Tourism and Lands Ref. No - 4-3/4/2021/LRB/211. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands/ Servitudes which are required for a public purpose. Purpose of the Acquisition-: Acquisition of the allotments of low lands to the government lying between Sri Maha Vihara Mawatha and Titus Gunathilake Mawatha adjacent to Cyril Janz Mawatha Panadura for the purpose of creating a water Reservoir, Water Pond/ pool and for the construction of Linear Park, Walkway and a Vehicle parking lot.
Description of the lands/ Servitudes to be acquired:

Boundaries for the below mentioned allotments of lands in total extent about 2.1067 Hectares depicted as Lot No 1 to 16 in the Folio No. 1 of Block No. 01 of the Cadastral Map No.530047 dated 22.02.2024 made by the Superintendent of surveys, kalutara situated in No. 682 B Atambagoda Grama Niladhari Division at Divisional Secretary;s Division—Panadura in Kalutara District western Province.
